scope: Tetrahedral cloth constraints with signed edge ownership and six-volume.

validation.case_scope: Two tetrahedra sharing a face validate ordered vertex IDs, positive signed six-volumes, three negative shared-edge lengths in the second cell, output shrinking, repeated reuse and complete cleanup. Reallocation fixture is in-place; moving allocation and degenerate geometry are source-reviewed only. Logical/ABI recovery only, not Full72, bitwise FP or gameplay proof.
